newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stronger European feeds see little trade.
newsitem.headline: Stronger European feeds see little trade.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw little trade this afternoon as higher seller prices and a steadier dollar kept most buyers sidelined, dealers said.
"We only saw a few trades in midprotein material this afternoon, even the further rise in Chicago soymeal futures failed to spark activity. These high prices dampened turnover," one broker said.

Spot EU rapemeal changed hands at 33 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine, afloat Thai tapioca fetched 17.50 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam and Malaysian palmkernel expellers traded at $104 a tonne cif Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
